#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("tbl.AF")
if (!exists("Vs30.docx", inherits = FALSE)) Vs30.docx <- 800
SiteID.caption <- .requireOneTarget(
  .currentTarget("siteID.target"), "siteID.target", "AF table caption"
)
if (!exists("Tn.target") || !length(Tn.target)) Tn.target <- Tn.gmdp
if (!exists("TR.target") || !length(TR.target)) TR.target <- TR.gmdp
if (!exists("p.target") || !length(p.target))  p.target  <- "mean"
Target <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
ID.target <- .resolveIDTarget(
  UHSTable,
  "AF.qmd",
  base = TRUE,
  target = Target,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
root <- here::here()
